ICS 29.200ETD 40New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (Part 2) (First Revision) which is identical with IEC TR 62001-2 : 2016 ‘High-voltage direct current (HVDC) systems - Guidance to the specification and design evaluation of AC filters - Part 2: Performance’ issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the HVDC Power Systems Sectional Committee and approval of the Electrotechnical Division Council.This standard was originally published in 2013 as IS 16071 : 2013 and was identical to IEC/TR 62001 : 2003. The first revision of this standard has been undertaken to align it with the latest international practices.
